messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands facing the water, then slowly turns around in a circle, briefly showing their profile before facing away again.","camera":"Static, medium full shot from behind the subject at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top, light green shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled up into a high ponytail or bun.","identity":"A muscular person with a dark complexion, seen mostly from behind, with a broad back and shoulders.","scene":"An outdoor stone patio or deck overlooking a calm ocean under a clear blue sky, with rocks and wooden posts visible at the water's edge."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person still stands in the same seaside patio scene and then turns around, briefly showing a profile and a hand raised near the face/chin, which resembles a thoughtful pose. The original identity, clothing, scene, and static rear camera framing are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose as demonstrated in the motion reference, while preserving the original person, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle hand-to-face gesture fully matches the reference's intended thoughtful pose.
unexpected_changes: The person performs a noticeable turn/rotation rather than remaining in a static thoughtful pose.
